scope: Accepted 1856-1857 batch-39 source-text rendering, special-markup, figure, authorship and chronology requirements only. Candidate documentation; no converter, transcript, export, training or accepted evidence changes.

requirements.case: 1632 plain reciprocal-looking digits and scoped reverse response
requirements.requirement: Preserve the three ordinary-digit strings 13542th, 13395th and 13600th exactly as printed plain text with no MathML restoration. A reciprocal-looking interpretation requires an authoritative witness and must not be inferred from typography. The accepted relationship is scoped reverse-only: 1632 answers the distinctive dog-breed subset of the missing/earlier exchange, while Hewson book receipt in 1801A is an intermediate receipt witness; do not expand it to a whole-letter or pigeon-results relation.

evidence.quote: The measurements of the Dog’s corpuscles
13542th, of the Dingo 13395th, & of the Wolf 13600th

requirements.case: 2160 Glover cactus hybrids and actual stem figure
requirements.requirement: Keep Glover’s October 26 response bounded by receipt of Darwin’s missing October 22 letter. Preserve approximate recollections (300–400 seeds, roughly equal germination, about 50 backcross plants) as uncounted/untested qualifications; the statement that Flagelliformis hybrids are fertile is belief pending further trial, while Gloxinia/Gesneria is explicitly barren. Preserve the actual unlabeled angular three-lobed stem drawing with corner spines and central mark; it has no measurements or scale. Specimens and reward are offers/claims, not completed transfer or purchase.

evidence.quote: Your letter of 22d. only came to hand this morning
It never occurred to me to count the number
I never tried them any further but I don’t doubt their being fertile.

figure.observation: Viewed angular three-lobed stem profile with corner spines and small central mark; no scale or labels.

requirements.case: 2003F George voice and excluded authorial quill aside
requirements.requirement: Retain George’s sixteen body blocks, including illness, stolen sweets, reading, paint storage and repeated wording such as “now now” and “to put to put”. The opening quill-pen sentence is a separate authorial George aside outside the retained body projection; preserve it as source provenance for the no-footnote/content policy rather than silently deleting or folding it into the letter. F does not mean the body is fragmentary, and missing Darwin/Pritchard communications remain missing.

evidence.quote: You need not have sent me to School Yesterday because today Mr. P Says I am to stop up in the sick room all day.
You must excuse bad writing in this page because I had an abominable quill pen

requirements.layer_note: Aside is raw body-content div before retained paragraphs; record separately from body voice projection.

requirements.case: 1987 joint recipients, sole Darwin author and future forwarding
requirements.requirement: Render 1987 as Charles Darwin’s single-authored letter to joint recipients George and William. The request that George forward it to William is a future instruction in the historical letter and does not prove forwarding. Funeral and will information belongs to Darwin’s report; later club minutes/account evidence must remain later corroboration, not inserted into this source. London travel, servants and departure remain planned/future where the body says so.

evidence.quote: I have thought that you would like to hear about poor Aunt Sarah’s funeral.
Do you Georgy send this letter soon on to Willy.

requirements.case: 1906 uncertain recipient and no fabricated incoming prompt
requirements.requirement: Preserve Darwin’s recipient as Robert Everest? with uncertainty, and retain the body as an inquiry about alleged Indian dog degeneracy. Falconer’s oral report, Darwin’s doubt, and the crossing confound are attributed separately; no later Variation citation or setter example may be substituted for a missing answer. A request for a response is not itself an incoming prompt or evidence of receipt.

evidence.quote: The danger of a cross seems the obvious source of error.
If you would be so kind, when at leisure, to answer this note
